cs.t: I have an ASUS RT-AX53U running OpenWRT for a few years now. I bought it, turned it on and flashed it out of the box lmao I like the idea of having their own hardware but it is not easy to get, so buying normal ones and flashing them still the best option.

I too use ASUS RT-AX53U. Decent hardware. But stock firmware was terribly slow. IPv6 didn't even work. I heard OpenWrt when I searched how to fix the stock firmware. Flashed it and never turned back. Now, OpenWrt is a critical infra in my house for adblocking, DoH, Firewall, Network Segmentation etc. None of these are possible with the stock firmware.
